DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis

Given the classic pattern of pain worsening with activity and improving with rest, along with involvement of weight-bearing joints (knees, hips) and the first metatarsophalangeal joint, osteoarthritis is the most likely diagnosis. I am ready to confirm this with imaging if needed, but your history strongly supports this conclusion.
